verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents an official CLI, glitchtip-cli, on its own docs page. It covers login, creating releases, recording deploys, uploading debug files, and injecting debug IDs and uploading source maps. The CLI is labeled Beta in the error-tracking docs, and its documented scope is release and artifact management rather than querying or triaging issues. Missing for 10: non-beta/stable status, independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of broader command coverage (e.g., issue browsing or machine-readable output) suited to AI-native workflows.
